sloka: अयोध्यायाः पती रामो दीर्घकालं भविष्यति ।सुखिनश्च समृद्धाश्च भविष्यन्त्यस्य ये ऽनुगाः ।। ७.५१.२२ ॥
transliteration: ayodhyāyāḥ patī rāmo dīrghakālaṁ bhaviṣyati ।sukhinaśca samṛddhāśca bhaviṣyantyasya ye 'nugāḥ ।। 7.51.22 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having ruled the kingdom for eleven thousand years, will then go to the world of Brahma.
